evidence.title: WildHandBench: A Benchmark for Handwritten Text Understanding that Challenges MLLMs and Humans

summary: Researchers introduce WildHandBench, a challenging benchmark designed to evaluate both AI models and humans on handwritten text comprehension. The tool highlights gaps in current multilingual language models' (MLLMs) performance.
title: WildHandBench: New Benchmark Tests AI and Human Abilities in Handwritten Text Understanding
